title: Toll Holdings Limited - completed acquisition of Victorian Express Pty Ltd

timeline.event: Toll Holdings Limited acquired Victorian Express Pty Ltd.
ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: In July 2007, Toll Holdings Limited acquired Victorian Express Pty Ltd which provided intrastate express freight services within Victoria.
body_sections.Market definition: For the purposes of assessing this acquisition, the ACCC considered the market for the supply of express freight services in Victoria.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant market.  The ACCC considered that Toll will continue to face competitive constraints from a number of alternative suppliers of express freight services and the threat of new entry or expansion.
